v01-woman-at-the-gym.observed_description: A woman of about thirty-five with short red hair, a grey sports top and black leggings lifts two dumbbells at shoulder height in a bright gym with dumbbell racks and machines behind her; the gym reads at 180 px.
v01-woman-at-the-gym.note: Accepted first time: The woman goes to the gym.

v02-man-cycles-to-work.observed_description: A man of about forty in a white shirt, dark tie and black backpack rides a black bicycle on a city street in front of a tall glass office building; the whole bicycle is in the photo.
v02-man-cycles-to-work.note: Accepted: He goes to work by bike.

v03-girl-with-camera.observed_description: A teenage girl with a long black braid and a yellow T-shirt holds a black camera with a large lens in a sunny park; the lens carries a tiny unreadable badge, invisible at phone size.
v03-girl-with-camera.note: Accepted: She has a camera. / It isn't a phone. It's a camera.

v04-boy-third-floor.observed_description: A boy of about ten with curly brown hair, a green hoodie and a red backpack stands beside a closed elevator door; one very large dark numeral 3 on the wall beside him, no other digit.
v04-boy-third-floor.note: Accepted: He lives on the third floor.

v05-woman-yellow-apples.observed_description: A grey-haired woman in a bright yellow sweater holds a paper bag of yellow apples at a market stall beside a crate of red apples; shoppers far behind are blurred.
v05-woman-yellow-apples.note: Accepted: She wants the yellow ones. / Her favorite color is yellow.

v06-girl-taller-boy.observed_description: A girl of about twelve in a light blue T-shirt stands a head taller than a boy of about seven in a navy T-shirt, both in grey shorts, against a plain wall; faces visible.
v06-girl-taller-boy.note: Accepted: The girl is taller than the boy. / Her shirt is light blue, but his shirt is dark blue.

v07-teen-phone-in-class.observed_description: A teenage boy with short blond hair and a red hoodie sits at a classroom desk and looks at a smartphone held in both hands, its screen toward him; a blue notebook on the desk, other desks empty.

v08-two-women-watches.observed_description: Two women at a café table, one with long brown hair in a white blouse and one with short black curly hair in a green blouse, each lift a wrist to show a large round wristwatch; two coffee cups on the table.
